turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope you're having a good Thursday. How are things going in Phoenix today? Are you feeling completely back to 100% after recovering from the flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, I'm feeling totally back to normal, thank goodness. The Phoenix heat is pretty intense today, so I started my morning with a big glass of chilled, slow-steeped coffee over ice. It really hit the spot.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds incredibly refreshing. Are you heading into the hospital for a night shift later, or do you have the afternoon off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do have a shift tonight. It's been a hectic day already, though. I actually had to completely skip my midday meal today. Normally I'd pack up some of my leftovers to eat, but I had back-to-back appointments scheduled all through the afternoon and simply didn't have a single free moment to eat.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no, that sounds exhausting! Running on empty before a busy ER shift is tough. How are you planning on getting to work? I hope you don't have to deal with stressful traffic on top of everything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: To make things easier on myself, I decided to book a ride through a car-hailing app tonight. It's much nicer to let someone else do the driving so I can just relax in the backseat before my shift starts.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is definitely a smart move to save your energy. Have you and Tom managed to get any salsa dancing in recently, or has life been too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually went out dancing on Tuesday night! It was so much fun, and Tom's steps are getting really smooth. It was nice to have some fun before this hectic stretch of work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful date night! Did you manage to get any sourdough baking done this week too, or has the summer heat made it tough to manage your starter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did feed my starter yesterday! With the kitchen being so warm, it rises super fast, so I have to be careful with the timing. I'm hoping to bake a fresh loaf tomorrow morning when I get home.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Fingers crossed for a perfect rise! Make sure you grab a quick bite at the hospital tonight since you missed your afternoon meal. I hope the ER isn't too chaotic for you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! I packed a quick snack to eat during a break, so I'll be fine. Ready to tackle the night!
